omarchy_keybindings.value: SUPER = modkey, SUPER+SPACE=launcher, SUPER+RETURN=terminal, SUPER+SHIFT+RETURN=browser, SUPER+SHIFT+F=files, SUPER+W=close window, SUPER+C/V/X=copy/paste/cut universal, SUPER+T=tiling toggle, SUPER+F=fullscreen, SUPER+L=workspace layout toggle, SUPER+J=split toggle, SUPER+P=pseudo window, SUPER+S=scratchpad, SUPER+arrow=focus, SUPER+SHIFT+arrow=swap window, SUPER+1-0=workspace, SUPER+SHIFT+1-0=move to workspace, SUPER+TAB=next workspace, SUPER+G=group toggle, SUPER+ESC=system menu, SUPER+K=keybindings menu, PRINT=screenshot, SUPER+PRINT=color picker, SUPER+CTRL+L=lock

media_keys.value: volume=brightness=mic=brightness keys via omarchy-swayosd-client, playerctl for music (next/prev/play/pause)

omarchy_menus.value: Super+SPACE=launch apps, Super+CTRL+E=emoji, Super+CTRL+C=capture, Super+CTRL+O=toggle menu, Super+CTRL+H=hardware, Super+ALT+SPACE=omarchy menu, Super+ESC=system menu

omarchy_toggles.value: Super+SHIFT+SPACE=topbar, Super+BACKSPACE=transparency, Super+CTRL+I=idle lock, Super+CTRL+N=nightlight, Super+CTRL+DELETE=laptop display

omarchy_workspaces.value: Super+1-0=switch workspace, Super+SHIFT+1-0=move window, Super+SHIFT+ALT+1-0=move silent, Super+SHIFT+ALT+arrows=move workspace to monitor

open_opencode.value: Cuando diga 'abra opencode': 1) computer_control action=hotkey keys=SUPER+RETURN para abrir terminal, 2) esperar 1 segundo, 3) computer_control action=type text='opencode', 4) computer_control action=press key=enter
